design_variables.purpose: Adjust measured exit axial energy to the MR target; voltage is not equated to kinetic energy.
Adjust extraction and time response together with pull and split side electrodes.
Adjust extraction and time response while preserving a physical electrode solution.
Keep shield and extraction-field boundary consistent with the chosen operating point.
Permit extraction gap/slit and source-to-focus geometry changes when required by MR acceptance; rebuild fields after changes.
Permit solid electrode and grounded-shield placement changes; reassess assembly clearances and field boundaries.
Permit a new physical extraction schedule; preserve instrument time and recompile native timing rather than resetting arrivals.
